events.title: Dark Side Playtest download will close on Sep 28, 2026, 01:00 PT.
events.summary: Dark Side Playtest download will close on Sep 28, 2026, 01:00 PT. Thank you all for playtesting. Your feedback has been extremely helpful. The new Demo will release on Oct 1, 2026. Come and try it out.

events.title: Dark Side Demo Releases on October 1st!
events.summary: Hi everyone! The public Demo for our mech game Dark Side is scheduled for October 1, 2026. You’ll get to try mech melee and aerial combat.Please note: The original Playtest build will be disabled after the Demo launches. This Demo is time-limited and will be taken down on October 31st. Don’t miss your chance to play!
